import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pandas.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pandas.DataFrame"]:
    inbound = inputs["inbound"]
    target_snapshot = inputs["target_snapshot"]

    # Step 1: build STG_NEW
    filtered = inbound[inbound["qty"] > 0]

    stg_new = (
        filtered.groupby(["product_id", "batch_date"], dropna=False)
        .agg(
            total_qty=("qty", "sum"),
            max_unit_cost=("unit_cost", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    stg_new = stg_new[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    # Step 2: delete rows from target_snapshot whose batch_date is among
    # the distinct batch_dates present in STG_NEW
    arriving_dates = set(stg_new["batch_date"].dropna().unique())

    if arriving_dates:
        keep_mask = ~target_snapshot["batch_date"].isin(arriving_dates)
    else:
        keep_mask = pd.Series(True, index=target_snapshot.index)

    survivors = target_snapshot[keep_mask]

    # Step 3: insert STG_NEW rows
    result = pd.concat([survivors, stg_new], ignore_index=True)

    result = result[["product_id", "batch_date", "total_qty", "max_unit_cost"]]

    return {"target_snapshot": result}
